in_marathi.name: Ujjawal
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ujjawal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ujjawal is derived from the Sanskrit word 'ujjwala' which means a 'victorious flame' or 'a flame that never goes out'. This name signifies strength, victory, and prosperity. It is a powerful name that inspires courage and determination.
